Evan (Sales): Hey team — Acme wants a short POC next week and asked for higher headroom on the dedicated pool during demo windows. Can we add elastic headroom + temporary reserved capacity? They also need hosted API keys for dev and a dedicated pool for the POC. 
Maya (SE): Yep. Dates? expected QPS during demo? also whether they need VPC/private or it's OK on hosted dedicated.
acme_pm: Hi — planning 3 days (Tue–Thu). Peak demo windows 11:30–12:30 and 16:00–17:00 PT. Expect ~120 concurrent requests during peak, mostly short chats. We prefer dedicated pool only; no VPC for this POC.
Ravi (Infra): Ok. From infra side we can temporarily increase pool max_replicas and add burst headroom. Suggest config: 
```json
{
  "pool": "dedicated-poc-acme",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 12,
  "burst_headroom": 6,
  "scaling_policy": "aggressive-10s"
}
```
This gives room for spikes without long cold-starts. Need approval for reserved GPU credits for 72 hours.
Evan (Sales): Thanks Ravi. What's the cost delta estimate for a 72-hour uplift to max 12 vs baseline 4? Need to send to procurement.
Ravi (Infra): Rough calc: baseline commit (4 gpus) -> uplift to 12 for 3 days = additional 8 gpu-hours * 24 * 3 = 576 gpu-hours. With trial pricing tier that's ~ $X (placeholder) — I'll confirm exact billing line with finance. Can we provision burst credits instead of full reservation?
Maya (SE): If we give burst credits, we can set a burst cap so they don't exceed budget. Also will create two API keys: one "acme-dev" (hosted) with rate limit 300rpm, and one tied to the dedicated pool for production-like tests.
Olga (Security): Quick sec note: since they opted out of VPC, ensure the PII SLA is kept; request that logs retention is set to 7 days and no customer data exported. Also send them our standard POC security questionnaire answers.
Evan (Sales): acme_pm — can you confirm budget approval for temporary reserved capacity or prefer burst credits? Also confirm if we should enable request/response logging for debugging (will be limited to 7 days).
acme_pm: Budget approved for burst credits only, not a full reserve. Enable logs for 7 days. Please proceed.
Ravi (Infra): Great. I'll apply these changes tomorrow morning and rollout canary first. CLI command I'll run: `rictl pools update dedicated-poc-acme --max 12 --burst 6 --scaling aggressive-10s` then monitor. deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: Pool update started for dedicated-poc-acme — rolling canary (step 1/3).
Maya (SE): I'll provision the two API keys and share with acme_pm in a secure snippet. Also I'll add a short runbook for demo times to avoid accidental load (simple throttling hints).
Evan (Sales): Awesome — target: have burst credits and keys in place by Monday EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ravi (Infra): Noted. I'll post final usage estimate after the initial tests tomorrow and tag finance.
Olga (Security): I'll send the POC questionnaire PDF and confirm log retention config.
acme_pm: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
